name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ui_menu, descriptor=saved_scroll_offset). Accurately reflects purpose (persisted/saved scroll offset for the shop menu, the saved companion to the live data_fd2_ui_menu_scroll_offset) and data type (a scalar offset/counter, accessed only as a dword). No Ghidra address residue: the trailing token 'offset' is a semantic word, not a hex literal; nothing in the name equals 0x5414f or any data address. No domain-ID stripping applicable.
purpose: Persisted shop-menu vertical scroll offset; the saved companion to the live data_fd2_ui_menu_scroll_offset (0x5412F). Preserves the visible scroll window of the shop item grid across the open/select/close dialog round trips so the list does not jump when the panel re-opens.
logic_summary: Save/restore scalar with three xrefs. fd2_run_buy_item_menu copies it into the live scroll offset before each panel re-open (0x2F1BA: MOV EAX,[0x5414F]; MOV [0x5412F],EAX) and snapshots the live offset back into it after the input loop returns (0x2F1F3 / preceding pair: MOV EAX,[0x5412F]; MOV [0x5414F],EAX). fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main resets it to 0 on menu entry, alongside the saved cursor data_fd2_ui_menu_saved_cursor_idx (0x2E4AB: MOV dword ptr [0x5414F],0). It always travels paired with the saved cursor index (0x5414B). Accessed as a full dword in every reference (the bytes c705/a1/a3 forms), never a byte/word slice.
datatype: uint32 (undefined4, 4 bytes); .object2 segment, zero-init (load-time zeroed, never preset in the image)
element_semantics: Single scalar = the top-row scroll offset of the shop item grid (0-based row index of the first visible item). Read/written only as a dword; mirrors the live data_fd2_ui_menu_scroll_offset so the scroll window survives panel re-opens.
notes: Verified all 3 xrefs against raw instruction bytes: 0x2E4AB = c7 05 4f 41 05 00 00 00 00 00 (MOV dword ptr [0x5414F],0, WRITE/reset in fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main); 0x2F1BA = a1 4f 41 05 00 (MOV EAX,[0x5414F]) + a3 2f 41 05 00 (MOV [0x5412F],EAX) (READ saved->live in fd2_run_buy_item_menu); the WRITE xref at 0x2F1F3 = a3 4f 41 05 00 (MOV [0x5414F],EAX) is the 2nd instr of the pair starting 0x2F1EE = a1 2f 41 05 00 (MOV EAX,[0x5412F]) (live->saved snapshot). fd2_run_buy_item_menu decompile confirms the exact save/restore pairing: 'data_fd2_ui_menu_scroll_offset = data_fd2_ui_menu_saved_scroll_offset' and the reverse. memory @0x5414F = all zeros; block=.object2, init=true (zero-filled LE BSS-equivalent). is_const=false: the game writes it at 0x2E4AB and 0x2F1F3. src comment block (chintro.c lines 836-851) is accurate and concise -> comment_verdict=keep, chintro.c NOT modified. Ghidra data plate was empty (PLATE_COMMENT null) -> created a concise plate from the verified src conclusion via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT + save_program (saved successfully).
